test_sample_op: test the TFClient sample method to retrieve items from a Reverb replay table with specified dtypes
test_update_priorities: test the TFClient update_priorities method to modify priorities of existing replay items by key
test_insert_op: test the TFClient insert method to add data tensors into one or more Reverb tables with priorities
create_tf_client: create a TFClient instance connected to a Reverb server address for TensorFlow graph-based replay access
test_insert_validation: test the TFClient insert method validates tables and priorities arguments for correct rank, dtype, and shape
